body.message:
We completely understand your situation, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. We truly appreciate you as a valued and well-maintained tenant, and we are grateful for your understanding and cooperation throughout your stay.

However, as per the decision of the landlord and management, we are unfortunately unable to reduce the rate at this time. As we are entering the start of the new season, the rates have been adjusted accordingly based on the current seasonal pricing.

We genuinely wish we could offer you a more favorable rate, especially considering your tenancy with us, but unfortunately, this is beyond our control. We sincerely hope you understand the situation and appreciate your kind understanding.
